name: Empowered Shot [Psionic]
body:
You can empower your ranged attacks, sending them farther.

Prerequisites: Point-Blank Shot.

Benefit: You may expend your psionic focus as part of a ranged attack (but not ranged touch attack) to ignore any penalties for range increment for that single attack. That attack still has its range doubled as if you were maintaining psionic focus.
